main_text.p: Ignis perpendicularis est exhalatio inæqualiter crassa, in supremo aere, formam columnæ pyramidalis referens.
Bolis est exhalatio æqualiter crassa, sagittæ ardentis ab una parte in aliam transcurrentis figuram reddens.
Candela accensa est exhalatio rara & subtilis, quæ ex æquo dilatabilis continuè in parte superiore accenditur.
Splendor nocturnus est exhalatio rarissima, & tenuis in summo aere accensa.
Capra saltans est exhalatio velut in duas partes divisa, longas quidem, sed latiores, quæ scintillatione sua quasi saltare videntur.
Scintilla volans est exhalatio in plures partes dispersa, singulis seorsim inflammatis.
Stella cadens est exhalatio superius inflammata, deorsum decurrens, ut cadere videatur.
Ignis fatuus est exhalatio candelæ instar accensæ oblongior. Hæc ventis agitata decliviora loca potis-simum petit: unde noctu iter facientes, si eam sequan-tur, in præcipitia feruntur.
Tonitru est exhalatio accensa cum sono e nubibus erumpens.
Coruscatio est accensum tonantis exhalationis lumen, altius super terram resplendens.
Fulmen est exhalatio coruscationi spissior artiusque composita, vehementius, & prope terram magis inardescens. Estque subtile, fuliginosum vel urens.
Subtile, quod nullo signo relicto, tacta quælibet perforat.
Fuliginosum, quod corpora, quæ transit, fuligine quadam relicta obfuscat.
Fulmen urens, quod multum ignis relinquit. Idcoq; ustibilia corpora facile accendit.

p.i: Hæc de ignitis Meteoris: sequuntur aquea.

page.notes: The running head and page number are read from the scan and are clear. The closing line is set in italic and is treated as a closing sentence, not a catchword. Long s is rendered as s throughout. The word "ar-tiusque" is hyphenated across a line end and rejoined as "artiusque". The "ct" in "artiusque" is a ligature in the print. "Idcoq;" is printed with the q-abbreviation and is kept as printed. No signature or catchword is visible.
